title: Ezekiel 1
paragraphs: ¹ In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was among the exiles by the Chebar River, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God. ² It was the fifth day of the month — the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's exile — ³ and the word of the LORD came clearly to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the Chebar River. The hand of the LORD rested on him there. ⁴ I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming from the north — an immense cloud with lightning flashing through it and brilliant light surrounding it. At the center, glowing like amber, was something like fire. ⁵ Out of the fire came what looked like four living creatures, and their appearance was human in form.

⁶ Each had four faces and four wings. ⁷ Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like calves' hooves; they gleamed like polished bronze. ⁸ Under their wings on all four sides they had human hands. All four had faces and wings, ⁹ and their wings touched each other. They moved straight ahead without turning. ¹⁰ Their faces looked like this: each of the four had a human face in front, a lion's face on the right, an ox's face on the left, and an eagle's face at the back.

¹¹ Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above them. Two wings of each creature touched the wings of the creatures beside it, and two wings covered their bodies. ¹² Each moved straight ahead — wherever the spirit directed, they went, without turning. ¹³ The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among them; it was bright, and lightning flashed from it. ¹⁴ The creatures darted back and forth like flashes of lightning. ¹⁵ As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each of the four-faced creatures.

¹⁶ The appearance of the wheels and their construction was like gleaming chrysolite, and all four looked alike. Their appearance and construction was as though one wheel were inside another. ¹⁷ As they moved they went in any of the four directions without turning as they moved. ¹⁸ Their rims were tall and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around. ¹⁹ When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them. ²⁰ Wherever the spirit would go, they went — and the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

²¹ When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, they stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose with them — because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels. ²² Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was something like a vault, gleaming like crystal, terrifying to behold. ²³ Under the vault their wings were spread out straight, one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body. ²⁴ When they moved, I heard the sound of their wings — like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings. ²⁵ Then from above the vault over their heads came a voice.

²⁶ Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of sapphire, and high above on the throne was a figure that looked like a human being. ²⁷ I saw what appeared to be glowing amber — like fire gleaming within it — from what appeared to be his waist upward. And from what appeared to be his waist downward, I saw what looked like fire, and brilliant light surrounded him. ²⁸ Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day was the appearance of the surrounding radiance. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
